fusions.name: Papercut Pass
fusions.desc: Sends a thin shadow-edged sheet into the first enemy it meets, dealing 3 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Closing Entry
fusions.desc: A long cut that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn.

fusions.name: Fresh Draft
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Reading
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
